Rod of Metamagic, Dazing
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 188, Advanced Player's Guide pg. 294
Aura strong (no school) CL 17th
Slot none; Price 14,000 gp (lesser), 54,000 gp (normal), 121,500 gp (greater); Weight 5 lbs.
Description
The wielder can cast up to three spells per day that daze affected creatures as though using the Dazing Spell feat (Advanced Player’s Guide).
Construction
Requirements Craft Rod, Dazing Spell; Cost 7,000 gp (lesser), 27,000 gp (normal), 60,750 gp (greater)
